item.title: Meta-Engineering: Why AI Agents Turned Me Into a Manager
item.author: Thomas Saulou
item.description: When an AI agent fails ten times in a row, the problem isn't the agent — it's the feedback loop. An essay on meta-engineering: building the systems that let autonomous agents ship correct code.
